description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: unclear with extended counter run, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: sofa in upper-left living area facing the dining and kitchen zone; dining table with six chairs along the upper-right exterior wall. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall opposite wall to entry. Cook may see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is bedroom doors, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom in a corner position — potential exposure on two sides. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor, desk visible. Secondary bedroom 2 — accessed via own door off corridor, desk visible. Each single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 2 of 2 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room / home office + children's bedroom simultaneously. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: families with two or more children; multi-generational households. Not suitable for: households needing ample storage — there are no wardrobes or storage rooms; large families requiring multiple bathrooms — only one bathroom; those wanting private ensuite master suite — master shares the single bathroom.
